message.content: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees get each year?

All full-time employees are entitled to 21 working days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Part-time employees receive leave on a pro-rata basis calculated against a standard 40-hour week. Leave accrues from the employee's start date at a rate of 1.75 days per month. Employees may not take annual leave during their first 30 days of employment.
